headlines.title_en: Japan sharply reduced its U.S. Treasury holdings in June; strategists expect no further reductions
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 18: Foreign holdings of US Treasuries fell in June, driven mainly by reductions from Japan and China. According to Treasury Department data released Monday, foreign holdings fell by $72.1 billion month-over-month to $9.3 trillion in June. Foreign holdings have declined in three of the past four months since hitting a record high in February. During this period, US Treasuries fell as investors worried about large fiscal deficits and above-target inflation. Japan, the largest holder, cut the most in June, reducing by about $26.4 billion to $1.12 trillion. The yen has remained under pressure in recent months, prompting intervention to stabilize the currency. The US joined intervention at the end of July. headlines.title: 中英日在6月均减持美债
headlines.summary: 美国财政部数据显示，6月英国、日本和中国持有的美国国债规模均较5月下降。其中，日本持有美债1.117万亿美元，较5月减少264亿美元；英国持有9399亿美元，环比减少87亿美元；中国持有6334亿美元，环比减少260亿美元。

headlines.summary_en: 【Digital RMB operating institutions expand to 30】Digital RMB operating institutions continue to expand. The PBOC announced on August 17 that Ping An Bank, Evergrowing Bank, Bohai Bank, Bank of Shanghai, Bank of Hangzhou, Huishang Bank, Bank of Changsha, and Guangxi Beibu Gulf Bank have been added as bank-type digital RMB operating institutions, connecting to the central bank's digital RMB system. The new institutions will launch digital RMB business after completing operational and technical preparations.

headlines.title_en: A signal of 0.01 percentage point, banking net interest margins see phased recovery
headlines.summary_en: According to data released by the National Financial Regulatory Administration for Q2 2026 banking and insurance regulatory indicators, commercial bank net interest margin was 1.41% in Q2, up 0.01 percentage points from 1.40% in Q1, the first quarter-on-quarter increase since 2022. However, trends varied by bank type, with large state-owned banks, city commercial banks, rural commercial banks, and private banks seeing Q2 NIM rises, joint-stock banks flat, and foreign banks declining.

headlines.title: 主动退出与被动处置并行，今年以来多家中小券商股权被摆上“货架”
headlines.summary: 近日，开源证券的一笔股权转让引发关注。开源证券的中小股东西安曲江文化金融控股（集团）有限公司，将其持有的开源证券股份（4784.60万股）全部挂牌转让，转让底价2.10亿元。据统计，今年以来，东海证券、大通证券等多家中小券商股权被摆上转让“货架”。中小券商股权流转的背后，是主动退出与被动处置两条主线并行。主动退出方面，股东财务状况是驱动因素之一。被动处置方面，股东债务触发司法拍卖的案例持续增加。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Voluntary exits and forced disposals in parallel; stakes of several small and medium-sized brokerages put on the 'shelf' this year
headlines.summary_en: A recent equity transfer at Kaiyuan Securities has drawn attention. Its small shareholder Xi'an Qujiang Cultural Financial Holdings (Group) listed its entire stake (47.846 million shares) for transfer at a base price of 210 million yuan. This year, stakes in multiple small and mid-sized brokers, including Donghai Securities and Datong Securities, have been put on the transfer shelf. The flows reflect two parallel tracks: active exits, driven partly by shareholder financial conditions, and passive disposal, with an increasing number of cases where shareholder debt triggers judicial auctions. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 存款“搬家”减速释放什么信号
headlines.summary: 【存款“搬家”减速释放什么信号】市场密切关注的“存款搬家”仍在持续，但已放慢脚步。中国人民银行近日发布的金融数据显示，7月人民币存款仅增加300亿元，同比少增4700亿元。其中：居民部门人民币存款净减少6300亿元，同比少减4800亿元；非银金融机构存款增加1.11万亿元，同比少增1.03万亿元。

headlines.title_en: What does the slowdown in deposit 'migration' signal
headlines.summary_en: 【What the slowdown in 'deposit migration' signals】The closely watched 'deposit migration' continues but has slowed. PBOC financial data shows July RMB deposits rose only 30 billion yuan, down 470 billion year-on-year. Of this, household deposits fell 630 billion yuan, down 480 billion year-on-year; non-bank financial institution deposits rose 1.11 trillion yuan, down 1.03 trillion year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: U.S. stock close: All three major indices fell collectively
headlines.summary_en: All three major US stock indices closed lower, with the S&P 500 down 0.52%, the Dow down 0.51%, and the Nasdaq down 0.32%. Among large tech stocks, SpaceX rose 4.45%, Micron rose 4.13%, ASML rose 2.12%, AMD fell 1.63%, Qualcomm fell 2.18%, Microsoft fell 3.04%, and Meta fell 3.54%. Among Chinese ADRs, XPeng rose 4.27%, Pinduoduo rose 2.54%, NIO rose 1.77%, Li Auto rose 1.22%, Bilibili fell 1.20%, and JD fell 1.93%.
